chunks: But when the unbelievers see you they make fun of you (and say): 'Is this the one who mentions your gods (deridingly)?' Yet in Ar-Rahman they disbelieve!
ai.seo_question: How did the disbelievers react to the Prophet Muhammad when they saw him?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Anbiya, this verse highlights the psychological dynamic where the disbelievers' mockery stems from their inability to comprehend the Prophet's dignity, revealing their own spiritual blindness to Allah. Shia exegesis often notes that this derision underscores the contrast between the Prophet's steadfastness in calling to Tawhid and the polytheists' entrenched disbelief in the Most Merciful. The verse serves as a reassurance to the Prophet that their ridicule is a sign of their own spiritual deficiency rather than a flaw in his message.
